title: Humming three-phase power boxes feeding underground

tellings.quote: he heard a humming. Mhm. And he kicks a bush aside, and there's this gigantic three-phase power power box with a cable definitely going into the ground.

plain: At Bradshaw Ranch, a property near Sedona, Arizona, a man named Paul heard a humming, kicked a bush aside and found a huge three-phase power box, the heavy-duty kind of electrical supply used for big machinery, with a cable running into the ground. Ross Coulthart, who says he has located a UFO base in Arizona, repeats this from Paul in 2025, as a sign that something is being powered underground there.
